entries.9bf81e049a8a1c40: The group consists of the company, 118 subsidiaries and 24 affiliates, and engages in seven businesses centered on the transportation business. The company itself operates railway business and real estate leasing, while group companies handle buses, taxis, trucks, hotels, department stores and others.
